    "Improved real-time collaboration and visibility across construction projects.",
    "Streamlined project workflows and task management compared to Excel.",
    "Centralized platform for managing diverse project-related data."

  "cons": [
    "Initial setup and migration from existing Excel sheets required significant effort.",
    "Some advanced features might have a steeper learning curve for the team.",
    "The cost could be a consideration for a smaller business if not fully utilized."
  ],
  "overall_experience": "The CEO found Smartsheet to be a significant upgrade from Excel for managing team collaboration and complex construction project workflows. While the initial transition required effort, the enhanced visibility and streamlined operations proved valuable for their small construction company. The platform delivered on its core promise, though some aspects of value for money and support were considered average."
